findings.title: `.small-action-desc` shrinks to content width inside flex container, breaking right-floated buttons
findings.body: Making `.small-action` a flex container (`@include flexbox()`) turns `.small-action-desc` into a flex item with default `flex: 0 1 auto` (`width: auto`) instead of a full-width block element. Because `.small-action-desc` no longer spans the full width of `.small-action` (e.g., via `width: 100%` or `flex: 1`), the edit/delete buttons (`button { float: right; }`) inside `.small-action-desc` will sit immediately next to the description text instead of aligning to the far right edge of the post row (and any `button` that is a direct child of `.small-action` will have `float: right` ignored entirely because floats do not apply to flex items).

findings.title: Header `.panel` can shrink and wrap when topic extra info is long, and fails to right-align in `-webkit-box`
findings.body:
With `.d-header .contents` changed to a flex container and `float: right` replaced by `margin-left: auto` on `.panel`, two layout issues arise:
1. Neither `.panel` nor `.title` has `flex-shrink: 0` (or `flex: 0 0 auto`). Because `.panel` contains floated children (`.icons`, `.login-button`, `button.sign-up-button`), when `.extra-info-wrapper` is shown in the header with a long topic title, the flex layout shrinks `.panel`, causing its floated buttons and icons to wrap onto multiple lines.
2. In legacy browsers that fall back to `display: -webkit-box` or `display: -moz-box` from `@mixin flexbox()`, `margin-left: auto` is ignored on box children, so `.panel` will sit adjacent to `.title` on the left instead of aligning to the right edge of the header.

findings.title: `align-items` mixin omits `-moz-box-align` and passes incompatible values to legacy syntaxes
findings.body: `@mixin align-items($alignment)` includes `-ms-align-items` (which is not a valid CSS property in any version of IE) while omitting `-moz-box-align: $alignment` even though `@mixin flexbox()` and `@mixin order()` emit `-moz-box` rules. Additionally, if standard values `flex-start` or `flex-end` are passed to `align-items`, `-webkit-box-align` and `-ms-flex-align` will be invalid because the 2009 and 2012 flexbox specs only accept `start` and `end`.
